title: A Good Name, Brick by Brick
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Wise Solomon had one more gift,
A treasure bright and true:
A good name shines like gold, he said,
And you can build yours too.

[Chorus]
So brick by brick, and day by day,
With every word you say,
Just tell the truth and keep your word —
Your good name grows that way.

[Verse 2]
It isn't silver, isn't gold,
It isn't toys or things;
It's being someone people trust,
And that's the joy it brings.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When no one saw the little break,
Beau chose the braver way:
He told the truth out loud and true,
And brighter grew his day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my honest one,
The day is tucked in tight;
Heavenly Father sees your heart
And keeps your good name bright.

[Chorus]
mood: Building music. A steady, even placing of one note after another under the voice, like a child setting one brick square on top of another and finding that the wall holds. Fingerpicked guitar keeping that patient, unhurried placing, with a warm sustained note underneath that arrives on the line where the truth is told. It settles a little lower with each verse, so the last line feels like something built and safe to sleep beside.
